title: About Me
text:
Hi, I’m Yingyi Guo, a graduate student in Business Analytics at Boston University with a background in landscape architecture.
My work sits at the intersection of data analysis, spatial thinking, and environmental systems. I am particularly interested in how data can be used to support decision-making in areas such as environmental planning, urban systems, and public infrastructure.




Data Analysis using Python, SQL, and Excel

Data Visualization with Tableau

Spatial Analysis with GIS (ArcGIS Pro, QGIS)

Machine Learning for prediction and classification

I enjoy transforming messy, real-world data into structured insights that can inform better decisions.




I am especially interested in:

Environmental data analysis

Water and ecological systems

Urban and infrastructure analytics

Data-driven decision-making in public sector projects





My goal is to work in a role where I can combine data analytics and spatial analysis to generate actionable insights, particularly in environmental or urban contexts.
I am actively looking for opportunities where I can apply my technical skills to real-world problems and continue building impactful data-driven solutions.
